title: Tree circuit complexity class inclusion
statement: For every natural number $i$, every language recognized by a family of Boolean tree circuits whose size is bounded by a polynomial and whose depth is at most $b(1+\log_2 n)^i$ for some constant $b$ at every input length $n$ is also recognized by such a family with fan-in at most two and depth at most $b'(1+\log_2 n)^{i+1}$ for some constant $b'$.
